apps.name: Explorer
apps.summary: A file manager in the spirit of Windows Explorer, with Finder kept out of the way.

apps.name: Desktop
apps.summary: The desktop in place of Finder's: free placement or a grid, stacks, Explorer's menus and shortcuts.

apps.name: Bar
apps.summary: A Dock in place of the system one: pinned and running apps, Downloads, minimized windows, the Trash.

apps.name: Viewer
apps.summary: The picture and PDF viewer, going through a folder in Explorer's order.

apps.name: Clipboard
apps.summary: Windows' clipboard history: hold Command V for your latest copies.

apps.name: Awake
apps.summary: Keeps the Mac awake, for a while or until stopped, even with the lid closed.

apps.name: Suite Settings
apps.summary: The settings of every app of the suite, and settings profiles.

apps.name: Suite Guard
apps.summary: Puts the system Dock, Finder's desktop and Spotlight's clipboard history back should an app that hid them vanish.
